This drawing covers the in-tree orchestration, alignment, preprocessing and output contract.
The named l weight is documented as iResNet100, but its ONNX operator graph is not present in the source repository.
Recognition and detector internals require inspecting the actual licensed ONNX artifacts. They are not reconstructed from the names.
